name: hourglass-baddie-mirror-selfie
image_purpose: Athleisure outfit post and fitting-room lifestyle visual

prompt.project_info: Create a high-fidelity smartphone mirror selfie in a small fitting-room or restroom interior.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with long voluminous light-brown hair, curtain bangs, lighter highlights, medium-tan skin, a large floral tattoo on the right forearm, and a gold clover-motif bracelet. She wears a loose blue T-shirt with black collar trim and vivid blue fitted athletic shorts, holding a white smartphone with a marble-patterned case while standing in a relaxed side-profile mirror pose.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical portrait framing from thighs upward, subject angled slightly away and turned toward the mirror, phone at chest height. Include textured beige wallpaper, dark speckled granite bench, pink tumbler with straw, car keys, and light square floor tiles.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffuse overhead fitting-room lighting, neutral-to-warm color temperature, realistic shadows beneath hair and chin, casual self-focused social-media atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Standard smartphone mirror-selfie lens look, vertical portrait, sharp subject and immediate background, realistic skin, hair, fabric and tile texture, subtle digital grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A high-fidelity vertical smartphone mirror selfie of one approved adult woman with long voluminous light-brown hair, curtain bangs, lighter highlights, medium-tan skin, a large floral tattoo on her right forearm, and a gold clover-motif bracelet. She wears a loose blue T-shirt with black collar trim and vivid blue fitted athletic shorts, holding a white smartphone with a marble-patterned case in a relaxed side-profile mirror pose. Include textured beige wallpaper, a dark speckled granite bench, a pink tumbler with straw, car keys, and light square floor tiles. Soft diffuse overhead light, realistic skin and fabric texture, standard smartphone perspective, subtle grain, and candid fitting-room lifestyle realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, explicit body-part emphasis, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, broken reflection, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference. Preserve identity, outfit, safe mirror pose, phone, room, props, and lighting. Tumbler, keys, and minor background details may be replaced; do not invent logos or typography. Any replacement person must be an approved adult.
